About the Team The DMS team is responsible for ensuring business continuity and peace of mind for more than 20 of our customers by delivering highly available, secure, and robust data recovery platforms. Our shared platform is fully segregated and consumed by customer teams via a self-service model, securing critical data and guaranteeing recoverability across both private and public cloud environments. You'll join a dedicated, group of passioned data security experts working within our larger Services Team. You’ll also work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. Here, you will dive into complex customer environments and support customer teams by providing strategic advice for optimal solutions, collaborate in RFIs/RFPs, and conduct in-depth data management assessments. Your focus: continuously improving platform features, driving innovation, and enhancing user experience. Working closely with technology vendors and our customer teams, you’ll ensure all data protection and resiliency standards are not only met, but exceeded, all while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and best-in-class practices. Our DMS platform is run on a segregated, dedicated private cloud infrastructure managed in-house for maximum resilience, spanning multiple availability zones. We integrate a wide array of storage targets, including public cloud services and S3-compatible platforms built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier. Work closely with the product teams of our technology vendors, driving them to continuously improve and enhance their products. Help customers protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and more. Deliver consumable, customer-centric features and capabilities end-to-end. Automate repetitive processes, continually optimizing platform operations and deployments. Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and assist in scoping and designing new solutions. Who Are You? First and foremost, you have a genuine passion for data protection, security, and resilience. You enjoy teamwork and thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers. You bring relevant experience as an engineer in data management/protection environments, with hands-on expertise in Commvault (strongly preferred) and/or Rubrik. You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments. Proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems. Experienced across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS). Skilled in Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef and have experience with scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.) Solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.
